answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 12031 Country: United States of America Title: Is there a dua to read so one can get married really soon? Question: Is there a dua to read so one can get married really soon? Answer ID: 12031 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 524/476=B/1430) One who wants to get married should recite ya Jami?u ( ياجامع ) 1111 times any time, while his or her parents should recite ya Lateef ( یا لطیف ) 1111 times after the Isha Salah. They shall receive good proposals soon, in-shaAllah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
